Create integration test at test/integration/controller-test-command-rejection.test.ts verifying SC-012. Covers FR-041, FR-042, SC-012.

tasks.title: Pre-signal executor: normal test verification via run_tests
tasks.description: Migrate pre-signal-executor.ts from shell commands to run_tests for normal test verification. (1) Replace getTddCommands()/shell execution with runTestsCore() call using scope=all, per FR-001. (2) Scope=all must execute all non-red tiers from .agent-test-config.json, per FR-002. (3) Fail if any test fails, per FR-003. (4) Pass with warning 'No tests found' if no tests configured, per FR-004. (5) On failure, output minimal message: 'Tests failed. Run \'run_tests scope=all\' for detailed diagnostics.', per FR-005. Excludes test/red/ from normal scope, per FR-014.

tasks.title: Pre-signal executor: TDD red-phase verification via scope=red
tasks.description: Update TDD red-phase pre-signal verification to use run_tests scope=red. (1) Update runTddRedPhaseTests() to call runTestsCore with scope=red instead of shell commands, per FR-010. (2) Implement inverted logic: pass if tests fail (failures expected in red phase), fail if ALL tests pass (signals promotion needed), per FR-011, FR-012. (3) If tdd_red_phase=true but test/red/ is empty, fail with 'Task requires TDD red-phase tests but none found', per FR-013. (4) Enforce tier-configured timeouts from .agent-test-config.json, per FR-014a.

quality_checks.description: Inverted logic present (pass when tests fail)

tasks.title: Directory-based TDD promotion workflow
tasks.description: Update TDD cleanup and promotion to use file move instead of content tag removal. (1) Update tdd-cleanup.ts: replace tag stripping with file rename/move from test/red/{tier}/ to test/{tier}/, per FR-016, FR-034. (2) Preserve subdirectory structure during promotion, per FR-017. (3) Remove // @orchestra-task: N comment from file content during promotion, per FR-018a. (4) Add destination conflict check: fail if target file exists, per FR-018. (5) Implement fail-fast for multi-file promotion (stop on first failure, already-promoted files remain), per FR-018b. (6) Update extractOrchestraTaskId() in tdd-marker-scanner.ts to read task ID from file content for task linking, per FR-024, FR-025.

tasks.title: Green phase verification implementation
tasks.description: Implement green task verification that checks linked red-phase tests pass. (1) Update signal-completion.ts to detect if current task is a green task via tdd_task_relationships lookup, per FR-027. (2) Add loadLinkedRedTaskFiles() to pre-signal-executor.ts to load tdd_red_registry entries by linked red_task_id, per FR-026. (3) Add runGreenPhaseVerification() that runs ONLY the linked red task's test files, per FR-028. (4) Pass if all linked tests pass, per FR-029. (5) Fail if any linked test fails with message 'Linked red-phase tests still failing', per FR-030. (6) On success, set tdd_task_relationships.completed_at, per FR-031.
